messages:
ada: Observed an uptick in cross-variant hedging during the last policy push for multi-tier tenants. p95 latency +25ms and hedges +2.1%. Logs show routers choosing different model variants for the same request id.
noah: I traced a few samples. The policy compiler emits semantically-equivalent routing graphs but with different tie-breaker ordering across builds. Routers compute candidate sets differently -> non-deterministic top choice.
rachel: ouch. So even if capacity and weighting are the same, ordering causes route mismatch and hedging. We should make the policy evaluation deterministic across replicas.
omar: concrete options: 1) stable sort on graph edges + canonicalized compile output (server-side), 2) attach a deterministic tie-breaker seed computed from request metadata, or 3) adopt a stateless decision-fingerprint that routers can compare. Tradeoffs: (1) changes compile pipeline, (2) deterministic seed may leak coupling to request id, (3) fingerprint requires canonicalization.
ada: (to clarify) I think we should avoid request-dependent tie-breakers because that can skew A/B. Prefer server-side canonicalization + fingerprint publish.
noah: agree. Proposal: policy-compiler produces canonical_plan proto (sorted fields, stable ids), we HMAC it -> decision_fingerprint. Publish fingerprint + compatibility flags with snapshot. Routers use fingerprint to prefer same-fingerprint candidates.
rachel: plus: runtime changes to propagate X-Decision-Fingerprint on request context so downstream hops prefer compatible choices for the life of the request. Also add explainability: decision_fingerprint in response metadata.
omar: fallback policy semantics: if fingerprint mismatch, router tries three levels: 1) prefer same-fingerprint route (bounded wait <=6ms), 2) if none, use compatible_with_degradation variants, 3) finally best-effort. Add per-tenant knob: fingerprint_mode = allow|prefer|strict.
ada: probes: synthetic probes are noisy. Add probe-origin-fingerprint and suppress probe-caused hedges when origin_fingerprint < local_fingerprint - 1 (i.e., out-of-date).
noah: tests: unit canonicalizer parity across languages; sim: replay recent 48h traffic with mixed compiles and measure hedges; e2e: critical prompt regression harness on snapshot publish for incompatible snapshots.
ci-bot: "build:policy-compiler-canonicalizer passed in staging (run 8423)"
rachel: rollout plan: land canonicalizer behind flag, publish fingerprints in staging, update a subset of routers to honor fingerprint with prefer semantics, run mixed-fingerprint sim for 12h, then 1% strict canary for tenants that can tolerate strictness.
omar: long-term: converge on single policy-eval runtime library used both by compiler test harness and routers to avoid drift. RFC follow-up: propose a small IDL and shared reference implementation.
ada: action items: noah implement canonicalizer + fingerprint publish, rachel update router runtime + propagation header, omar draft RFC for shared eval runtime, ada own sim and metrics dashboards.
noah: will also add telemetry: routing.fingerprint_mismatch_count, routing.prefer_wait_ms.p95, routing.hedge_rate_by_fingerprint.
rachel: good. I'll schedule a short RFC review Friday. ping me if you want to pair on router changes. :thumbsup:
